turns.content:
[College group, 9:14 pm]
Sameer: [reel: rooftop infinity pool, Dubai skyline] good times 🥂
Tushar: bhai ke paas toh aadha Gurgaon hai ab, lifestyle dekho
Sameer: expanding soon boys, watch this space 😎
---
[DM, 11:52 pm]
Sameer: Faisal, chhota sa kaam. ek dost ke liye puchh raha hoon — tumhari company mein koi opening hai? operations ya general management side. 15-18 LPA bracket chalega.
Sameer: woh isi mahine move karna chah raha hai. solid banda hai, saalon apna setup chalaya hai.
Sameer: aur yaar group mein iska zikr mat karna, woh private rakhta hai yeh sab.
Faisal: arre haan haan pakka, Monday ko HR se puchhta hoon 👍
---
[College group, agle din, 1:30 pm]
Faisal: reunion ka venue toh set hai phir — Sameer bhai sponsor karenge, business boom kar raha hai 😂
Tushar: 😂😂 gym king
Sameer: 👍
---
[DM, teen din baad]
Faisal: bhai, HR ne dost ka CV manga hai, bhej doge?
Faisal: hello? bhai?

---
1. Sameer ke DM mein "dost" kaun hai aur tumhe kaise pata? Third-person wala frame Sameer ke liye kya kaam kar raha hai — yahi costume kyun?
2. Agle din Faisal ke group message ne Sameer ke saath kya kiya, trace karo. DM chup kyun ho gaya — thumbs-up, joke, aur teen din ki silence ko jodo.
3. Woh DM likho jo Faisal ko ab bhejna chahiye, bilkul waisa jaisa bhejna chahiye — jo Sameer ko asli help dilaye bina usse kuch bhi admit karwaye.

1. "Dost" Sameer khud hai. Transcript se pata chalta hai kyunki: (a) Sameer ne khud likha “ek dost ke liye puchh raha hoon” aur turant baad “group mein iska zikr mat karna, woh private rakhta hai”; (b) jo details diye — “isi mahine move karna chah raha hai”, “saalon apna setup chalaya hai” — woh Sameer ke group wale dikhāwe se match karte hain (business boom, expanding soon).  
Third-person frame Sameer ko do kaam deta hai: pehle toh direct maangne ki bajaye indirect rakh kar reject hone ka risk kam karta hai, doosra group mein hero wali image ko intact rakhta hai bina kisi ko pata chale ki woh khud job dhoond raha hai.

2. Faisal ne agle din group mein likha “Sameer bhai sponsor karenge, business boom kar raha hai” — yeh Sameer ke liye public endorsement ban gaya, usne 👍 dekar accept bhi kiya. Iske baad DM mein Faisal ke “HR ne CV manga hai” wale message ka koi jawab nahi aaya. Thumbs-up + joke ne baat ko group level pe le aaya, jisse Sameer ko lagā hoga ki ab privacy wali baat khatam ho gayi, isliye teen din ki silence.

3. Faisal ab yeh DM bhej sakta hai:  
“Bhai, woh dost wali baat pe HR ne kaha hai agar koi specific profile hai toh uska naam aur last role bata do, warna general applications hi forward kar denge. Tu bata kya karna hai.”
